description: One nudge per session toward the system map before the first Grep in a mapped repository with code facts. Fails open.

args: p=$(command -v cartographer); s=; case "$p" in */shims/*) s=$p; p= ;; esac; if [ -z "$p" ] && command -v mise >/dev/null 2>&1; then p=$(mise -C / exec github:shermanhuman/cartographer -- sh -c 'command -v cartographer' </dev/null 2>/dev/null); case "$p" in */shims/*) p= ;; esac; fi; [ -z "$p" ] && p=$s; [ -n "$p" ] && "$p" hook grep; exit 0
